guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation table horizontal scroll accessible code blocks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), maintain sequential headings, use <caption> and <th scope> on tables, and provide explicit keyboard focus styles on scrollable regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, sequential h1/h2/h3, captioned tables with <th scope>, and focusable .table-wrap regions wired via aria-labelledby with a 3px :focus-visible outline.
